name: CoMER INT8 (ONNX) as published by ink-on

vocab.json.note: the release copy uses CRLF line endings, the git tree copy LF; the parsed JSON is identical (second digest = LF-normalised)

vocabulary.note: 113 is the number of tokens in the file, equal to the decoder's logits dimension and to the release notes. The ink-on README states 245, which is wrong.

decoder_int8.onnx.note: no key/value cache: every step re-feeds the whole prefix

runtime.referenceRuns: onnxruntime-node 1.21 (Node 22) for the unmodified ink-on code; onnxruntime 1.24 (Python) for metadata inspection

license.why: The weights derive from CoMER (Green-Wood/CoMER). That upstream repository contains no LICENSE file and ships CROHME training data with its own terms; ink-on provides no model card (no checkpoint, quantisation provenance or data terms). Apache-2.0 from ink-on's author cannot grant rights the author may not hold.

distribution: This project does NOT contain the model binaries. scripts/fetch_comer_models.py installs the three files into app/src/main/assets/models/comer/ at build time, verifying the SHA-256 digests above.
